(b) Technical Specifications:- (i) All items shall conform to the latest applicable BIS/IS specifications or equivalent international st andards. (ii) Electrical items shall comply with relevant BIS standards and applicable provisions of the Nation al Electrical Code. The items shall be suitable for low temperature operation. (iii) Plumbing items shall be corrosion-resistant and suitable for portable water applications. (iv) Paints shall be exterior/interior grade, weather-resistant and suitable for cold climatic conditions . Paints, sealants, adhesives and similar consumables shall have a suitable shelf life and application cha racteristics for high altitude conditions. It shall be supplied in a manufacturer’s original sealed container s with valid batch number and manufacturing date. (v) Carpenter items shall be durable, seasoned and free from manufacturing defects. (c) Quality Requirements:- Only premium quality products shall be accepted. Items shall be free from defects in material and work manship and shall be capable of reliable performance under the climatic conditions prevailing in Leh. The water storage tanks shall be of reputed brands such as Sintex, Supreme, Vectus or equivalent. The PPR items shall be of reputed brands such as Finolex, Astral, Supreme or equivalent. The wires and cables shall be of reputed brands such as Polycab, KEI, Havells, Anchor or equivalent. The wires and cables shall conform to the relevant BIS standards (such as IS 694 for PVC insulated and othe r applicable standards based on cable type). The paints shall be of reputed brands such as Asian Paints, Berger, Nerolac or equivalent.
